title: Neonatal Aicardi-Goutières syndrome presenting with macrophage activation syndrome-like hyperinflammation and severe congenital glaucoma: a case report.
snippet: Neonatal-onset Aicardi-Goutières syndrome (AGS) is a rare monogenic type I interferonopathy that may mimic congenital infection and can present with severe multisystem inflammation. The distinction between primary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) and AGS-associated macrophage activation syndrome (MAS)-like hyperinflammation can be challenging i...
